name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
steps: Sit at a preacher bench with the backs of both upper arms on the pad and a dumbbell in each hand, palms up.
Curl the dumbbells toward your shoulders while your elbows stay supported.
Lower the dumbbells until your elbows are nearly straight.
tips: Maintain full upper-arm contact with the pad through the descent.
Stop just short of snapping your elbows straight at the bottom and keep your wrists neutral.
